MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The third-generation Echo Dot and Smart Plug feel useful because they could add voice control and lamp automation alongside my existing Fire TV devices.",
    "The memory card and reader connect to my recent camcorder purchase and interest in handling recordings, provided the card is compatible."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Kindle and tablets do not meet a current need: my recent screen purchases support television viewing, not reading or portable tablet use.",
    "Neither pair of earbuds addresses a listening need I have expressed, and I have no established Apple-device use that makes AirPods especially relevant.",
    "The Fire TV Cube fits my interests but duplicates functions my Stick 4K and Fire TV television already provide; I would also choose one Echo Dot rather than both generations."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Fire TV products seems to have been taken as interest in Amazon devices generally, even when they serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in more gadgets, rather than purchases for specific home-viewing and recording needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters now is whether a device adds a useful capability to equipment I already own, rather than repeating an existing function.",
    "Accessories for my camcorder interest me only when compatibility is clear; a general connection to storage is not enough to choose them.",
    "I shop selectively when there is a practical use, so interest in connected-home equipment does not mean I currently need another screen or listening device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in connected-home entertainment, but stretched it into unrelated gadgets and replacements for functions I already have."
}
